helpCenter.content:
Here's what you need to know

Annual leave
Employees in Sri Lanka are entitled to 14 days of annual leave each year. 7 of those days must be taken consecutively.

Casual leave
Employees are entitled to up to 14 days of casual leave per year.

During the first calendar year of their start date, employees are entitled to 7 days of casual leave. They also accrue 1 day of annual leave per 2 months of completed service during that first calendar year.

Starting January 1 of their second calendar year, the employee is entitled to casual leave as follows:

  • 14 days if they started work between January 1 and April 1 of the previous year.
  • 10 days if they started work between April 1 and July 1 of the previous year.
  • 7 days if they started work between July 1 and October 1 of the previous year.
  • 4 days if they started work between October 1 and December 31 of the previous year.
helpCenter.title: Paid time off in Sri Lanka
